content.content:
# User-approved visual goal — 2026-11-18 ~15:00 UTC (account 13) — BINDING for every specialist and every future Claude account

The user approved this understanding in their own words: "YES, CLAUDIA. I approve your visual-first plan for all five original
approved Rainbow screens." It adds to (never replaces) `docs/briefs/2026-11-18-r11/USER_ORDER_R11_STRICT.md`,
`docs/briefs/2026-11-18-r10/RULES_R10.md` and `docs/briefs/2026-11-18-r8/COMMON_RULES.md`.

## 1. What the user wants
* The user ALREADY DESIGNED the game. The approved pictures `references/04_…png` … `references/08_…png` are BLUEPRINTS, not
  inspiration: recreate THOSE exact environments as faithfully as technically possible as real playable 3D.
* The scenery must look like the approved world THROUGHOUT Benny's natural swimming — start, middle, end, and while he steers hard
  left / right. A matching first screenshot that turns into a generic tunnel is a failure.
* No redesign, no simplification, no added or different scenery, no generic orange ring corridor, no flat blue/ramp water, no giant
  foam walls, no stretched / smeared / torn textures, no double-exposed or duplicate rings, no clipping, no style drift.
* Where a picture does not show a deeper area, continue the SAME design faithfully; show any new visual interpretation to the user
  for approval before treating it as accepted.
* Benny: the exact pink fluffy mascot, purple / white striped beanie, yellow star; same size, proportions and fur; swimming
  naturally IN the water (not hovering, not sunk, never overlapped by scenery).
* Visual success = the ACTUAL PLAYABLE GAME looks noticeably closer to the approved picture. Plugins, cameras, code, depth maps or
  models are not successes by themselves. Biggest visible difference first; keep only real improvements, reject the rest.
* Target ≥ 8.5/10 throughout gameplay, ideally 9–9.5/10, judged honestly by eye. Nothing is finished until the USER approves it.
* Only screens 04–08. Screens 01–03 and 09–11 (cartoon girl, Google Flow videos) are handled by the user — never rebuild them.

## 2. What each approved picture contains (rebuild THIS)
* **04 Through the Five Arrows** — pink laundry-room opening (porthole window, control panel with shirt icon, striped towels,
  gold washer rim, big bubbles), then a deep telescoping tunnel of FEW, THICK, polished yellow-gold rings with light dots; a thick
  glossy cyan river with magenta / pink swirls curving up the sides; FIVE glowing white-cyan chevrons down the lane AHEAD of Benny
  (clearly visible, never overlapping him — user, 2026-11-18 ~15:00); gold coins to the left of the lane; soft LOW foam along the
  water edges; iridescent bubbles.
* **05 Flow Into the Current** — purple slotted metal tunnel with glossy gold ring bands and gold paddle lids, bright far throat;
  wide glossy cyan river with hot-pink satin bands in S-curves; puffy white foam clouds on both banks; centre coin line; Benny's
  white splash wake.
* **06 Crest the Rinse Arch** — the river rises in a sweeping crest, curves left, then bends right into an OFF-CENTRE gold-ring
  tunnel (not a straight bullseye); gold paddle lids upper left; purple slotted walls; coins along the crest; ripple rings round
  Benny; foam clouds in the lower corners.
* **07 Dive the Washer Tube** — deep purple slotted tube with many gold rings and gold paddles on the left; a winding cyan river
  with thick magenta banks plunging away; foam clouds; coins.
* **08 Final Spin Chamber** — wide drum chamber framed by a huge gold ring; the silver washer door with porthole at the far end over
  a gold-rimmed perforated platform with a folded purple towel; four gold-banded spout cups with pink perforated caps pouring from
  their undersides; S-river with coins through purple perforated walls and floor.

## 3. How (method kept)
Real 3D geometry fitted to each picture (rings, walls, river channel at measured positions / heights, depth maps in
`qa/da3/2026-11-18/`), the approved pixels projected / baked only where the geometry is right, faithful continuation materials for
unseen parts; every change a URL switch, the default build unchanged; tested at the start view, forward ≈3 / 6 / 10 / 20 u, end and
hard left / right. Tools only when they directly help the visual match; no paid jobs without the user's approval and a cost.

## 4. Proof (every meaningful change)
Separate full-size APPROVED / BEFORE / NEW renders from the REAL playable game at start, intermediate, end and hard left / right
(no collages for approval), a short real-gameplay swimming clip when useful, and a plain-words verdict: GOOD IMPROVEMENT / NOT AN
IMPROVEMENT / NOT YET PROVEN. Never pass colour percentages or technical milestones off as visual success.

## 5. Always
Five-minute GitHub autosave incl. unfinished specialist work; never merge, force-push or overwrite another account's branches;
preserve every successful improvement; coins (91 / score continuity), physics, input, HUD and Android performance unchanged; two
specialists at a time, rotating 05 + 08 now → 07 → 06 (04 = lead); never pause authorized specialist work without the user's OK.
